text:
Maya: Heads up — someone's at the lobby saying they're with Emerald Partners for a 3pm with me but the visitor form wasn't filled out. Can someone grab them a temporary badge?
Front Desk: Front Desk: We have them — name shows "Emerald Partners" contact for 'Maya Patel'. Badge printer is jammed, can do a handwritten badge if that's ok. Also a courier just dropped a small box addressed to 'Ethan' with no last name, labeled 'CONFIDENTIAL - samples'.
Ethan: That's probably mine — I'm on a call, could someone hold it for me? Please put it in Locker A2 if possible.
Sam: I can do Locker A2. I opened the box to check and uh — it's tiny sample tubes and a single foil-wrapped sandwich? Not sure how those got labeled 'confidential'.
Aditi: I'll head down to the lobby and print a temp badge from the spare printer in the kitchen. If printer 3 is jammed, use the dot-matrix in the workshop.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll be down in 5. Also planning to use the window couch for the meeting, hope that's ok.
Sophia: Dibs on the window couch from 3:30 — I have a quick 1:1 after you, happy to move if needed. :smile:
Front Desk: Front Desk: Temporary badge made: "Visitor - Emerald (Maya)" taped to lanyard. Keycode for conference gate given: 1432. Locker A2 labeled and box placed inside.
SecurityBot: SecurityBot: Log entry created - visitor checked in (name: Maya Patel), badge issued, package received and secured in Locker A2.
Ethan: Thanks @Sam and @Front Desk. I'll swing by after the call to grab the samples/sandwich. If anyone wants half the sandwich, claim it now :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sam: I'll take half. Leave it in the small fridge in the kitchen with a post-it 'Sam — do not eat if allergic to sesame'.
Aditi: Printer 3 cleared, badge station back online. If anyone else checks in, please use the scanner and ask guests to fill the visitor form at https://forms.internal/visitors
Maya: All good here. Meeting started, visitor settled, couch defended. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
Sophia: Enjoy the meeting. Also, FYI — there's a mystery parcel in mailroom shelf 2B (no name) that says 'promo kit'. Can someone check before Friday?
Front Desk: Front Desk: Noted — we'll hold it and ping perms for pickup.
Maya: Can we add a quick note to the onboarding doc to remind hosts to fill the visitor form ahead of scheduled meetings? Saves everyone 5-10 mins.
Aditi: Done — added line to onboarding checklist and linked the form.
Ethan: Appreciate it. And sandwich survived. :salute:
